result:
All changes are in place, both `bun run typecheck` and `bun test` pass.

## Summary

Made the post excerpt optional and auto-derived from the body when left blank:

- **`app/Support/excerpt.ts`** (new): `deriveExcerpt(body)` — trims the body, returns it unchanged if ≤140 chars, otherwise takes the first 140 chars without splitting a word (backing up to the last whitespace when the cut lands mid-word, or cutting at exactly 140 if there's no whitespace at all), trims trailing whitespace, and appends `…`.
- **`app/Http/Validators/PostValidator.ts`**: `excerpt` on `PostPayloadSchema` changed from required (`min(1)`) to `.optional()`, so missing/empty/whitespace-only excerpts pass validation (still trimmed, still capped at 500 chars); title/body validation unchanged.
- **`app/Http/Controllers/PostController.ts`**: `store()` and `update()` now compute `data.excerpt || deriveExcerpt(data.body)` before saving, so a blank excerpt is derived from the (new) body on both create and update, while a provided excerpt always wins.
- **`.guren/api-client.gen.ts`**: regenerated via `bun run codegen` so the generated `posts.store`/`posts.update` body types mark `excerpt` optional.
- **`resources/js/pages/posts/New.tsx` / `Edit.tsx`**: label now reads "Excerpt (optional)" with a placeholder explaining the fallback.
- **Tests**: added `tests/excerpt.test.ts` (covers both worked examples from the spec plus short-body, whitespace-trimming, no-whitespace-in-window, and non-empty-result cases) and `tests/PostValidator.test.ts` (missing/empty/whitespace excerpt accepted and trimmed; blank title/body still rejected).
